snippet.title: Microsoft Flight Simulator | Local Legend 25: The Heinkel He 70 Blitz
snippet.description: The Microsoft Flight Simulator Heinkel He 70 Blitz is now ready for simmers to explore the world. The aircraft ships with several historically precise liveries, including those officially licensed by Lufthansa. It is available today in the in-sim marketplace for $14.99 USD. The sky is calling!
